name: clayworks-lite
description: Operator scaffolding for Claude Code that I built without writing the code. I share it as the free MIT foundation of the Clayworks operator system, for builders without a coding background.

plugins.name: clayworks-lite
plugins.description: Operator scaffolding for Claude Code. I load three skills on install (Nudge SQLite reminders, a multi-memory routing decision tree, a heartbeat-pattern concept) and wire a UserPromptSubmit hook that surfaces your due Nudge reminders automatically. I also put annotated hook examples for the eight hook events I reach for most, a CLAUDE.md starter template, a composed settings.example.json, worked configurations, and design-rationale docs on disk for you to reference, copy, and customize.
